global_style: An elegant, minimalist presentation template featuring a warm Morandi palette, fluid organic framing shapes, and delicate structural line accents.

identity_anchors: Overlapping, paper-cut style organic curves anchored at the corners.
Fine, intersecting orthogonal lines providing a subtle background grid.
Pill-shaped badges and rounded rectangles for interactive-looking elements.
Soft, gradient-free flat coloring with very subtle, diffuse drop shadows for depth.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
